difficulty_reason: Prove the diagonal of Complexesstack_{X/B} is affine and of finite presentation: representability is quot-lemma-complexes-diagonal, reducing to Isom(E, E') -> T for two fibre objects E, E'; define the SheafHom functors H, H', I, I' (each affine of finite presentation over T by quot-lemma-complexes-open-neg-exts-vanishing) and express Isom(E, E') = (H' x_T H) x_{c, I x_T I', sigma} T with c(phi', phi) = (phi after phi', phi' after phi) and sigma = (id, id) - compare quot-proposition-isom; fibre products of affine fp spaces over T stay affine and of finite presentation.
